_about: The landmark buildings that become territory gyms. Consumed by design/build-campus.py (footprint resolution: `match` = OSM way/relation name, `at` = verified centroid with nearest unclaimed footprint within 55 m, `synth` = [length, width, height] in metres massed from the centroid) and by the server (venueKey ties a monument to the gazetteer). `venue` is the short display name the renderer matches shift locations against.
